title: Critique: mind and body are too different in kind to interact

statements.text: The simplest objection is that mind and body, being of radically different kinds, lack the common ground needed for interaction. Gassendi and Princess Elisabeth already asked how a nonspatial soul could act on an extended body.

sources.quote: they lack that communality necessary for interaction
expressed difficulty seeing how a non-spatial soul could interact with a body that has the property of extension
